rows.note: Use this for moving, travelling, or spreading around a large area, rather than for abstract scope.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zau1 wai4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose sense of covering a broad range, such as reading widely or discussing many areas.

example.english: I read extensively across different kinds of books.
example.traditional: 我廣泛咁睇唔同類型嘅書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gwong2 faan6 gam2 tai2 m4 tung4 leoi6 jing4 ge3 syu1

rows.jyutping: hai2 hou2 daai6 cing4 dou6 soeng6
rows.note: Use this formal phrase when something is true or happens to a great extent.

example.english: This policy has extensively improved people's lives.
example.traditional: 呢個政策喺好大程度上改善咗市民嘅生活。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zing3 caak3 hai2 hou2 daai6 cing4 dou6 soeng6 goi2 sin6 zo2 si5 man4 ge3 sang1 wut6
